summary: Xeris Biopharma filed an 8-K reporting privately negotiated exchange agreements with noteholders to exchange ~$23M (69%) of its 8.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028 for cash (principal amount) plus common stock valued using a 21-day VWAP. $10.5M of notes will remain outstanding. Closing expected ~July 15, 2026. The exchange reduces debt overhang and is a form of capital return via liability management; shares issued will be unregistered under Section 4(a)(2). Watch for the VWAP calculation and remaining noteholder dynamics.
